replacements.La relación entre energía y desarrollo h: The relationship between energy and human development is not linear
replacements.Los primeros kilovatios producen saltos: The first kilowatt-hours produce enormous gains in well-being. Beyond a certain point, each additional kilowatt-hour produces much less return. A specific threshold separates basic access from advanced human development.
replacements.Curva kWh per cápita anual vs Índice de: Annual kWh per capita vs Human Development Index curve
replacements.La curva no es lineal: el impacto de un: The curve is not linear: the impact of an additional kilowatt-hour depends on where you start. The elasticity estimate (0.64–0.94% more perceived well-being for each additional 1% of energy) comes from a panel of 47 countries controlling for income, urbanization and climate. Source: Lee et al. (2020), ESMAP/World Bank (2015).
replacements.Cada kilovatio aquí puede cambiar la vid: Every kilowatt-hour here can change a household's life. The slope is steepest: this is the range where the impact on health, logistics and education is most pronounced.
replacements.Luz artificial nocturna y sustitución de: Night-time artificial light and replacement of kerosene or firewood. This reduces chronic respiratory disease, a leading cause of mortality in low-income households, and extends useful hours for study and work.
replacements.Conservación de vacunas, alimentos y med: Preservation of vaccines, food and medicines. Pumping of drinking water. The first level at which basic healthcare infrastructure can operate reliably.
replacements.Análisis básicos de laboratorio, cirugía: Basic laboratory tests, scheduled surgery and classroom lighting. The World Bank identifies the 50–200 kWh range as the zone where returns in health and basic productivity are most pronounced (Multi-Tier Framework, MTF).
replacements.Manufactura básica, irrigación y partici: Basic manufacturing, irrigation and economic participation
replacements.Maquinaria eléctrica pequeña, bombas de: Small electrical machinery, irrigation pumps (2–3× agricultural yield in areas with water deficits), and integration into commercial networks. This is the range where the local economy begins connecting to broader markets.
replacements.El estudio de Dinkelman (2011) sobre Sud: Dinkelman's (2011) study of South Africa documented that women in electrified areas were 23% more likely to enter the labor market, attributable to fewer hours spent on subsistence household tasks rather than changes in labor demand.
replacements.La pendiente se aplana. Cada kilovatio a: The slope flattens. Each additional kilowatt-hour still adds value, but the difference between having it and not having it no longer changes lives as radically as it did at the beginning.
replacements.El kilovatio extra puede ser la diferenc: The extra kilowatt-hour can be the difference between having light tonight and not having it
replacements.Puede conservar o no conservar las vacun: It can determine whether a health center can preserve its vaccines
replacements.Puede hacer funcionar o no una bomba de: It can determine whether a drinking-water pump can operate for the day
replacements.Impacto potencialmente vital. Umbral cua: Potentially life-changing impact. A qualitative threshold.
replacements.El kilovatio extra puede equivaler a una: The extra kilowatt-hour can amount to one additional washing-machine cycle per week
replacements.Un rato más de climatización o iluminaci: A little more heating, cooling or decorative lighting
replacements.Una fracción de tiempo de un servidor de: A fraction of the operating time of a low-power server
replacements.Impacto marginal. Mejora de confort, no: Marginal impact. Better comfort, not additional basic capability.
replacements.Esto no significa que el consumo energét: This does not mean high energy consumption is irrelevant: industrial productivity and GDP remain correlated with consumption. But the impact on basic human well-being shows clearly diminishing returns beyond a certain threshold. The optimal policy is to expand access, not increase consumption where there is already a surplus.
replacements.Dos reglas que emergen de los datos hist: Two rules emerge from historical data covering 190+ countries. Together they describe when electricity stops being the limiting factor for human development.
replacements.Ningún país con IDH ≥ 0,9 tiene menos de: No country with HDI ≥ 0.9 consumes less than 4,000 kWh/capita/year
replacements.Ningún caso documentado en más de 60 año: No documented case across more than 60 years of Human Development Index data. Below this threshold, high human development has not occurred in any context, regardless of other institutional or geographic variables.
replacements.No todos los países que superan 4.000 kW: Not every country above 4,000 kWh has reached HDI ≥ 0.9
replacements.La electricidad por encima de ese umbral: Electricity above that threshold is necessary but not determinative. Whether energy potential translates into broadly shared well-being depends on institutional, distributive and educational factors, not energy alone.
replacements.Si la IA requiere electricidad estable y: If AI requires stable and abundant electricity to operate well, and access remains unequal globally, the well-being gap that electrification helped reduce can reappear in a new form with AI as the vector.
